_comment: FORMAT-CHECK request: one recent daytime scan to answer whether satpy's reader handles MOSDAC's CURRENT product. Credentials read from the gitignored .env -- leave empty here.
_corrected: Parameter names, date format, bbox order and count ceiling all follow https://mosdac.gov.in/downloadapi-manual. An earlier version of this file used fromDate/toDate with DDMMMYYYY dates and a lat-first bbox -- all four were wrong and are a likely cause of a parameter error.
_verify_nesting: The manual documents the parameters but we could not retrieve a verbatim example config. Check the sample config shipped inside https://mosdac.gov.in/software/mdapi.zip and adjust the section names if they differ.

search_parameters._datasetId: 3SIMG_L1B_STD is the manual's own example and is INSAT-3DS (operational Feb 2024) -- most likely for recent dates. Alternatives if it errors: 3DRIMG_L1B_STD (INSAT-3DR), 3DIMG_L1B_STD (INSAT-3D, confirmed working for 2019, may now be archive-only). Catalog browser: https://mosdac.gov.in/catalog/satellite.php
search_parameters._date_format: YYYY-MM-DD per the manual (example: 2024-09-25). NOT DDMMMYYYY -- that is the FILENAME convention, not the API's.
search_parameters._count: Manual states a ceiling of 100 records per request. There is no 'unlimited'.
search_parameters._boundingBox_empty_because: Full disk deliberately: the format check must exercise the same product geometry the reader was written against, and a spatial subset could mask a geometry change.

_target_window: A monsoon afternoon so VIS/SWIR are lit and the reflective checks actually run rather than being reported N/A. If the API supports a time-of-day filter, target 0800-0900 UTC = 1330-1430 IST; otherwise take any granule from that window in the returned listing.
_expected_size: ~400 MB for one full-disk L1B scan (measured on the 2019 file).
_after_download: cd /Users/evad/nowcast && .venv/bin/python -c "from nowcast_data.insat import ingest_scan; a,c = ingest_scan('PATH.h5', strict=False); print(c.report())"  then diff the printed identity block against docs/INSAT_FORMAT_CHECK.md
